rule: Project is the primary data ownership level.
behavior: Resolve project through plan/batch; reject cross-project relationships.
message: Choose a project you can access.
exceptions: Server authorization required.

rule: Schoolnet Admin manages all projects; other users see their authorized scope.
behavior: Scope all queries and actions; assigned trainer batches and own trainee data.
message: You do not have permission to access this record.
exceptions: Q1: exact ERNET/state/school boundaries and grants required; demo scopes in assumptions.

rule: Automatically select the sole assigned project for a project administrator.
behavior: Hide repetitive project selection; two or more projects use switcher.
message: Project selected automatically.
exceptions: Q17: behavior with two/more projects and other roles unresolved.

rule: Maintain a central employee/consultant trainer pool with codes, availability and assignment history.
behavior: Create/view trainer records; derive assignment history from batches.
message: Trainer saved locally.
exceptions: Q1/Q6: other master editors, mandatory fields and trainer lifecycle unresolved.

rule: Trainers/Admins can add, change, remove and view future trainer availability.
behavior: Save date intervals; trainer edits own availability.
message: Availability saved locally.
exceptions: Q4: past/today edits, hours, overlaps and utilization undefined.

rule: Use national, state and project holidays when creating/modifying schedules.
behavior: Check inclusive dates against applicable holiday records.
message: Training conflicts with an applicable holiday.
exceptions: Q4: state selection, blocking versus override unresolved. Demo blocks.

rule: Support common resources and project/plan-specific resources.
behavior: Store file bytes in IndexedDB and metadata in localStorage; link to plan.
message: Resource file stored in this browser.
exceptions: Q12: common eligibility, approval and removal unresolved.

rule: Forms become available on their assigned day until project end.
behavior: Compare batch start + day offset and project end date.
message: This activity is not available on this date.
exceptions: Q6/Q12: project date changes and completed-project access unresolved.

rule: Authorized administrators can create projects selected from an Odoo project list.
behavior: Search sample Odoo list; save local project record with date/description.
message: Project saved locally; Odoo is simulated.
exceptions: Q1/Q2: edit/delete grants, values, Odoo contract/outage and code origin unresolved.

rule: Project Code must be unique.
behavior: Compare normalized code against existing projects.
message: Project code already exists.
exceptions: Q2: duplicate name policy undefined; code supplied from demo Odoo list.

rule: Project Start Date must be strictly before Project End Date.
behavior: Reject equal or reversed dates.
message: Project start date must be before end date.
exceptions: Conflict Q3 says date order absent. Enforce explicit §5 pending confirmation; no past-date ban/time cutoff.

rule: Every plan belongs to a project; a project may have multiple plans.
behavior: Require a visible project; keep project foreign key.
message: Select a project.
exceptions: Q1: exact plan write grants unresolved.

rule: Training plans have a defined duration and a unique automatically generated code.
behavior: Generate TP + unique id; save training type and days.
message: Enter the training duration.
exceptions: Q5: number format and uniqueness scope unresolved; positive integers and globally unique UUIDs are demo assumptions.

rule: Each resource/form may link to one or more days within plan duration.
behavior: Reject day less than 1 or greater than duration; store multiple links.
message: Resource day must be within the plan duration.
exceptions: Q5: positive whole day policy assumed; duplicate day links prevented as UX.

rule: Changes to used plans affecting historical records must be controlled/audited.
behavior: Lock structural changes to used plan; allow audited description/name changes.
message: This plan is in use; structural changes need an approved versioning policy.
exceptions: Q5/Q12: final versioning/edit/delete policy unresolved; conservative demo lock.

rule: Each batch belongs to one project and one training plan from that project.
behavior: Filter plans by project; validate plan/project match.
message: Select a training plan belonging to this project.
exceptions: Q1: trainer creation/modify/delete limits unresolved; admin demo editor.

rule: Batch creation is primarily through Excel upload.
behavior: Parse first XLSX worksheet; preview every row; block invalid import; commit validated rows atomically.
message: Review the row errors before saving this import.
exceptions: Q7: accepted Excel variants/columns/partial saving unresolved; demo XLSX contract documented.

rule: Training dates must be inside the project period.
behavior: Reject dates before project start or after project end.
message: Batch dates must fall within the project period.
exceptions: Conflict Q3 says boundaries absent. Explicit §7 enforced; batch end >= start is demo assumption.

rule: Maximum batch capacity cannot be exceeded.
behavior: Count registered records; reject over-capacity registration or capacity below enrollment.
message: Batch capacity has been reached.
exceptions: Q8: maximum size range, location capacity and overrides undefined; no override in demo.

rule: Assigned trainer must be available throughout the training period.
behavior: Require availability interval covering all dates; check holidays.
message: Trainer is not available for the entire batch period.
exceptions: Q4: hours and overlap rules undefined; interval coverage demo model.

rule: Batch editing/deletion requires authorization and upload/edit validation.
behavior: Revalidate all conditions; block deletion with child records.
message: Batch has linked records; deletion policy requires clarification.
exceptions: Q1/Q8/Q10: grants, historical deletion and closure policy unresolved; no cascade assumed.

rule: User-entered location is reference; actual location is derived from UDISE.
behavior: Use sample school directory; preserve separate reference location.
message: Select a valid school / UDISE code.
exceptions: Q2/Q7: real directory integration unavailable; sample mapping labelled.

rule: Trainer/Admin may upload trainee lists through Excel.
behavior: Validate batch access, duplicate key, capacity; preview and atomic commit.
message: Trainees imported and stored locally.
exceptions: Q7/Q14: exact columns and personal data policy unresolved.

rule: Open registration is enabled/disabled per batch with an applicable batch link.
behavior: Expose batch-specific URL fragment; reject disabled/closed batch registration.
message: Registration is closed for this batch.
exceptions: Q9: time window/timezone and final-closure upload rules unresolved.

rule: Open registration uses mobile, email where applicable, and OTP verification.
behavior: Demonstrate OTP challenge 123456; do not send SMS/email; save only after demo verification.
message: Enter the displayed demo OTP to verify.
exceptions: Q14/Q15: fields, expiry, retries, delivery and lockout unclear; no real OTP/security.

rule: Search for a trainee Unique ID using mobile/email.
behavior: Return only matching masked identifiers after demo OTP verification.
message: No matching trainee ID found.
exceptions: Q15: match and disclosure policy undefined; server identity verification needed.

rule: Registration may be Day 1 only unless business decides otherwise.
behavior: Review setting selects Day 1 demo or within-batch demo; visibly provisional.
message: Registration is outside the prototype review window.
exceptions: Q9: conditional proposal, not finalized; Asia/Kolkata demo dates.

rule: Trainer/Admin can close registration and upload trainees while open registration is enabled.
behavior: Closing stops self-registration; bulk uploads still allowed before final closure.
message: Registration closed locally.
exceptions: Q9: uploads after final closure unresolved; demo blocks them.

rule: Trainer must approve the trainee list before final batch closure.
behavior: Trainer approves each record; closure rejects any unapproved record.
message: Approve the entire trainee list before final closure.
exceptions: Q10: junk/rejection/approval reversal and reopening unresolved; closure also waits for configured completion.

rule: Prevent duplicate trainee registration.
behavior: Demo duplicate identity = normalized mobile or email in same batch.
message: This trainee is already registered in this batch.
exceptions: Q10: identity scope and re-registration unresolved; no cross-batch ban assumed.

rule: Resources linked to a plan are available to its batches; common resources may be reused.
behavior: Link common resource to one or more plans; project-specific links require matching project.
message: This resource is outside the project scope.
exceptions: Q12: common repository eligibility and propagation approvals unresolved.

rule: Trainers may upload resources when permission is provided.
behavior: Reviewer can explicitly grant trainer upload in demo permissions; default denied.
message: Resource upload permission is required.
exceptions: Q1: who provides grant and scope needs sign-off.

rule: Trainer resources may optionally become common; new plan resources may reach existing batches.
behavior: Admin-only demo common creation; reviewer opt-in new links for existing batches.
message: Business clarification required: repository approval/propagation policy.
exceptions: Q12: both conditional, conservative default off for used plans.

rule: Assigned trainer primarily records Present/Absent per trainee/batch/date.
behavior: Require every listed trainee marked; key by batch+date+trainee.
message: Mark Present or Absent for each trainee.
exceptions: Attendance bulk upload is confirmed by the 5 October user update. Exact additional-role grants, missing marks, batch bounds and final-closure corrections remain documented review contracts.

rule: Attendance may be recorded today or previously, never for future dates.
behavior: Compare Asia/Kolkata date; reject future; demo additionally confines to batch period.
message: Attendance cannot be marked for a future date.
exceptions: Q11/Q29: correction cutoff/approval and batch bounds unclear; no cutoff invented.

rule: Attendance modifications and important changes must be auditable.
behavior: Record actor/date/action/masked before/after; include report downloads.
message: Change recorded in the local audit trail.
exceptions: Retention, immutable server auditing and correction approval unresolved.

classification: Confirmed configurable completion; proposed indicators unresolved
rule: Completion requires configured attendance, days and assessment/form rules.
behavior: Remain undetermined until reviewer supplies provisional thresholds; show evidence; never issue by default.
message: Business clarification required: completion criteria are not configured.
exceptions: No default attendance percentage, pass score or mandatory form requirement inferred.

classification: Suggested or recommended behavior, pending sign-off

behavior: Not Started/In Progress derived from dates for demo; Completed only after configured closure; no cancellation shortcut.
message: Business clarification required: cancellation and date-change policy.
exceptions: Suggested lifecycle; Upcoming is dashboard category (§13), not extra persisted status.

classification: Suggested or recommended behavior, pending sign-off
rule: Suggested trainee stages include Registered, Approved, Training Started, Training Completed, Assessment Completed, Certified, Dropped/Inactive.
behavior: Registration, approval, started are evidence-derived; completion gated by review config; dropped deferred.
message: Complete the prerequisite stage first.
exceptions: Transition reversals/dropped status and exact mandatory conditions unresolved.

rule: Support configurable certificate templates with all listed certificate fields, logos and colors.
behavior: Store template; show synthetic name only in certificate preview; download printable HTML, visibly demo.
message: Demo certificate preview generated.
exceptions: Q6/Q29: issuer, certificate numbering and eligibility unresolved; no production certificate issued.

rule: Provide role-appropriate dashboards.
behavior: Filter project/state/school/assigned batch/self and display documented KPI categories.
message: No training records are available in this scope.
exceptions: Q13: denominators, refresh, metric definitions unresolved; derived demo measures labelled.

rule: Central dashboard shows project, plan, batch, pipeline, attendance, assessment and feedback measures.
behavior: Compute visible-record totals; provide pipeline, status, state and monthly aggregates.
message: Metric definition pending where denominator is unspecified.
exceptions: Planned trainees = batch capacity in demo; active project = date period; explicit assumptions.

classification: Suggested or recommended behavior, pending sign-off
rule: State/ERNET dashboard shows school/batch/trainee/availability and pending alerts.
behavior: Monitor scoped records; available/pending measures derived from recorded evidence.
message: No exceptions detected from configured rules.
exceptions: Soon/low attendance/insufficient registration thresholds require clarification.

rule: School dashboard shows teacher progress, dates and assigned trainers.
behavior: School filter; upcoming batch table and scoped progress.
message: No school training is assigned.
exceptions: Teacher versus student population unclear Q11/Q13; demo trainees labelled teacher.

rule: Trainer dashboard shows today’s work and quick operational actions.
behavior: Assigned batch counts; attendance/form pending; attendance, trainees, resources, plan and closure links.
message: No batch is scheduled for today.
exceptions: Completion/active definitions provisional.

rule: Trainee dashboard shows own training, activities, resources, forms, attendance, certificate and progress.
behavior: Restrict self record; date-based activity gating and evidence-based attendance.
message: No training is assigned to this trainee.
exceptions: Day completed definition and certificate eligibility unresolved.

classification: Suggested or recommended behavior, pending sign-off
rule: Provide MIS project, batch, attendance, trainer availability, lifecycle, resource use, login/activity, profile audit and exceptions views.
behavior: Derive scoped tables; export actual Excel/CSV; print for user Save as PDF.
message: Report exported from the current filtered view.
exceptions: Recommended reports not finalized; exact metrics/retention/Excel rights need Q13 sign-off.

rule: Track resource upload metadata, unique users, accesses and last access.
behavior: Increment only when bytes/open succeeds; demo session user identifier distinguishes personas.
message: Resource opened.
exceptions: Not LMS analytics; only this browser’s activity.

rule: Track registered/active/inactive users, logins, failed attempts and OTP activity.
behavior: Record persona entry and OTP test outcomes; real failed login/lockout unavailable.
message: Demo activity recorded.
exceptions: Q15: failed threshold, 15-minute scope/reset and OTP expiry unresolved.

rule: Audit permitted profile changes with date/user/field/old/new/changed-by.
behavior: Mask personal before/after; never capture plaintext passwords.
message: Profile changes saved locally.
exceptions: Personal fields, edit rights and masking policies Q14 unresolved; demo name/contact only.

classification: Suggested or recommended behavior, pending sign-off
rule: Management reports should have common project/state/district/school/plan/type/batch/trainer/date/status filters and scoped downloads.
behavior: Apply each filter before generating table/export; role scope always precedes filters.
message: No records match the selected filters.
exceptions: Filters are recommended; PDF where required unresolved. User print supports PDF without claiming generated PDF.

rule: Protect personal data through masking and encrypted production storage.
behavior: Demo uses synthetic personal data; mask names/contact outside final preview; explicitly label unencrypted localStorage.
message: Use synthetic data only. Browser storage is not encrypted.
exceptions: Q14 conflict: masked database vs clear final names and encryption of all data; server design unresolved.

classification: Business clarification required; production implementation dependency
rule: Login attempt lockout, OTP expiry, input/extension allowlists and hidden URL behavior need definition.
behavior: Document server obligations; provide persona review entry, not a real authentication system.
message: Business clarification required: authentication/security settings.
exceptions: Do not manufacture login thresholds, OTP minutes or production security.

rule: Schoolnet Admin manages users and role/project assignments.
behavior: Create synthetic users; edit role/project/state/school assignments; scope uses stored values.
message: User assignment saved locally.
exceptions: Q1: full permission matrix and account lifecycle policy pending.

message: You do not have permission to perform this action in this scope.
exceptions: Business clarification required: who grants permission, project/plan scope and grant expiry. Browser permissions only demonstrate behavior; server ACL enforcement required.

source: User update · Training / Learning Resources · reaffirmed 3 October 2026 (v4.2)

message: Common repository request saved locally; awaiting administrator review.

source: User update · Training / Learning Resources · reaffirmed 3 October 2026 (v4.2)
rule: New resources linked to a commonly used Training Plan Code may become available to existing batches.

message: Existing batches included for this resource link.
exceptions: Business clarification required: automatic versus explicit propagation, completed-batch treatment, retroactive assessment effects and reversal. Existing baseline links retain legacy review setting. New links ignore that global switch.

source: User update · Training / Learning Resources · reaffirmed 3 October 2026 (v4.2)
rule: Supported resource types include PPT/PPTX, PDF, video and other approved multimedia formats.
trigger: Upload, link, permission or common publication action
behavior: PPT/PPTX and PDF always supported. Demo video list starts MP4/WEBM. Admin review-approved extension list allows other video/multimedia formats such as MOV/PNG after explicit review. Unlisted formats are blocked before storing bytes.
message: This format is not approved in the prototype. Ask the administrator to review the multimedia allowlist.
exceptions: Business clarification required: exact approved video/multimedia formats, MIME/content validation and file-size limits. MP4/WEBM defaults and extension-only checking are temporary demo choices; no business size cap invented.

source: User update · Training / Learning Resources · reaffirmed 3 October 2026 (v4.2)
rule: Prototype uploads retain actual bytes and must report storage failure honestly.
trigger: Upload, link, permission or common publication action
behavior: Store bytes in IndexedDB, then metadata/link in localStorage. Byte failure saves no metadata. Metadata failure rolls back records and attempts to remove uploaded bytes. Open/download retrieves stored bytes. Prevent duplicate in-flight saves.
message: File was not stored: [storage error].
exceptions: Technical prototype implementation item: browser quota, deletion failures, site-data clearing and separate storage transactions can affect durability; production needs server storage/transactions, scanning and audit.

rule: Training plans are independent reusable master templates, not project-specific.
behavior: No Project field in plan editor. Active masters may be assigned to multiple batches across permitted projects.
message: Select a project.
exceptions: Exact editor roles remain Business clarification required; central Admin grant retained for the demo.

rule: Capture Name, immutable auto Code, Type, Description and Number of Training Days.
behavior: Staged create/edit/duplicate supports Induction, Refresher 1, Refresher 2 and Other. Name and whole-number duration are required.
message: Enter a Training Plan Name. / Select Induction, Refresher 1, Refresher 2 or Other.
exceptions: Description mandatory status and character limits require business clarification; description optional in prototype.

rule: Each training plan must contain a minimum of 4 whole training days.
behavior: Show the exact minimum-duration error; duration changes regenerate day choices. Out-of-range mappings remain visible and block Save.
message: Enter a positive whole number of training days. / Duration cannot exclude an assigned resource/form day.
exceptions: Positive integer numbering is a prototype assumption; no upper limit, hours or calendar exclusion rule invented.

rule: Automatically generate unique sequential Training Plan Codes, retaining them on rename.
behavior: New masters use TP-0001 style codes with a persistent sequence. Duplicate receives a new code and editable temporary Copy name before save. Legacy codes and references are preserved.
message: Training Plan Code already exists.
exceptions: Format and uniqueness scope require business clarification. Prototype uniqueness is global and server must enforce it atomically.

rule: Multiple resources/forms can be assigned to each training day.
behavior: Type-filtered Resource Name dropdown, valid Day dropdown and Add/Update button precede the immediate assigned table. Edit/delete are staged; exact resource/type/day duplicates are blocked; day cards update immediately.
message: Select one or more days within the training duration.
exceptions: Every day does not have to contain a resource; optional training/activity notes are a proposed UX improvement. Existing plan-wide materials remain supported until explicitly day-assigned.

rule: A resource cannot be assigned beyond training duration.
behavior: The Day dropdown lists 1..duration; save revalidates all mappings. Duration reduction keeps conflicting rows and warns which days must be reassigned or removed.
message: Select one or more days within the training duration.
exceptions: Day-to-date mapping remains consecutive calendar-day prototype assumption. Holidays/weekends require confirmation.

rule: Historical batches retain the version assigned; subsequent master changes are audited.
behavior: Batch assignment stores code, name, type, duration, description, day notes and link snapshot. Admin can edit used masters for future assignments. Existing batches retain their snapshot. Explicit existing-resource propagation remains audited and project/day constrained.
message: This plan is in use. Create a revised plan for structural changes.
exceptions: PROTOTYPE ASSUMPTION: independent revision/new code, metadata reason, no automatic reassignment, future empty batch reassignment allowed with audit. Approval/version activation, deletion/removal and rollback policy require business clarification. Browser audit is mutable, not production audit.

rule: Provide Digital Teaching – Induction, TP-0001, Induction, 4 days and the ten requested sample mappings.
behavior: Fresh/reset demo seeds three resources on Day 1, three on Day 2, two on Day 3 and two on Day 4. Existing stored records migrate without reseeding or changing legacy codes.
message: Four-day sample plan created: [generated code].
exceptions: Example is optional sample data, not a requirement imposed on every training program. Does not change existing batches or learner completion evidence.

rule: Every batch must belong to exactly one project.
behavior: Require a permitted project. Project/state/school scope checked during create, Excel preview, commit and editing.
message: Project/school is outside your authorized batch scope.
exceptions: Project must be available to the user; detailed roles/grants require confirmation.

rule: Every batch must be linked to exactly one training plan.
behavior: Require a valid Training Plan Code belonging to the selected project; dependent searchable list on manual edit.
message: Select a training plan belonging to this project.
exceptions: Started or registered batch plan reassignment blocked to protect history; future empty reassignment is audited, pending policy sign-off.

rule: Training dates must fall within the project period.
behavior: Use valid dates and check start/end inclusively against project dates on upload and every edit.
message: Batch dates must fall within the project period.
exceptions: End on/after start is a prototype assumption. Past-date/noon cutoff or plan-duration/date-span equality not imposed.

rule: Registered batch size must not exceed Maximum Batch Size.
behavior: Count all registrations including pending approval; reject capacity reduction below enrollment and reject full-batch self/bulk registration.

behavior: Check inclusive training period against national, school-derived state and project holiday records. Recheck when saving staged imports.

exceptions: Demo blocks conflicts; applicable holiday ownership, override approvals and alternative dates require clarification.

message: You do not have permission to perform this action in this scope.
exceptions: Grant matrix is prototype assumption. Deletion with trainees/attendance or final closure is blocked pending business policy; closed batch editing/reopening remains unresolved. Server ACLs required.

rule: Capture all listed Batch information; Excel is the primary creation route.

message: Batch ID already exists (prototype global scope). / Open Registration must be Yes or No.
exceptions: Code format/global uniqueness, exact mandatory field status and length limits need clarification. Manual code is UUID prefilled but editable; Excel IDs are supplied by uploader.

message: Trainer Code already exists.
exceptions: Local POC: server permissions/storage/audit and business sign-off remain required. Imports are additive; XLSX first worksheet only.
